heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 106–65, div. C, title XXXII, § 3294(d)(1), Oct. 5, 1999, 113 Stat. 970

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 95–91, title II, § 212, as added Pub. L. 103–337, div. C, title XXXI, § 3158(a), Oct. 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 3093, established the Office of Fissile Materials Disposition.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Mar. 1, 2000, see section 3299 of Pub. L. 106–65, set out as an Effective Date note under section 2401 of Title 50, War and National Defense.
